caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden wardrobe with two paneled doors, rendered in tones of light to medium brown to represent a natural wood grain texture. The wardrobe features a prominent, molded cornice at the top, adding a decorative element above the main rectangular form of the cabinet. Each of the two doors is segmented into three raised panels, and both are equipped with simple, dark-colored handles and hinges. The base of the wardrobe has two symmetrical curved cutouts on either side, giving the structure stability and subtle ornamentation. The background is plain and light-colored, placing full emphasis on the wardrobe, which is shown in a three-quarter perspective to display both the front and the right side.
title: Pine Wardrobe
